name: Raquete emprestada
prompt: Flat 2D cartoon animation in the exact style of the image: thick black outlines, flat colours, no shading, no texture. Static locked camera, no zoom, no pan. Plain solid green background that never changes. A chubby bean-shaped pink pig standing upright, wearing a light blue headband, light blue wristbands, white socks and black Vans trainers, with pig hooves (never fingers), holds a tennis racket by the handle in his front hoof, on the right of the image. The racket is tilted at about 45 degrees, its head pointing up and to the right. He stares at the racket, confused, as if he has never held one. Then he passes it to his other hoof: as the free hoof on the left reaches for the handle, the racket slowly rotates counter-clockwise, and when the free hoof clamps the handle the racket has turned 90 degrees, now tilted at about 45 degrees the other way, its head pointing up and to the left. He stares at it again, still puzzled, and gives a small shrug. Then he passes it back: as the first hoof reaches for the handle, the racket slowly rotates clockwise back to its starting angle, head pointing up and to the right, and the first hoof clamps it by the handle. He ends in exactly the starting pose, identical to the first frame. The racket is held by the handle in every single frame: always gripped by at least one hoof, during each pass both hooves hold the handle at the same moment, and it never floats, flies or leaves the hooves. Movements are stiff, short and silly, like a simple cut-out cartoon; no elbows, no knees. Feet stay planted on the same spot the whole time. The pig keeps the same size, shape and colours throughout.
negative_prompt: camera movement, zoom, pan, background change, shading, gradients, 3D, realistic, human hands, fingers, extra limbs, extra arms, morphing, melting, warping, flicker, floating racket, racket flying, racket in mid-air, dropped racket, text, logo, blur, distortion, low quality
